calculation_handling.description: A crisis care shelter must occupy the entire building and not be combined with any other use.
calculation_handling.gaps: No vocabulary requirement for sole-occupancy of a building.

units.disclosure: The rule that a crisis care shelter occupies the entire building with no other use is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A crisis care shelter must be regulated or supervised under Province of Ontario or Government of Canada legislation.
calculation_handling.gaps: Regulatory status of an operator is not a lot or scenario input.

units.disclosure: The requirement that a crisis care shelter be provincially or federally regulated or supervised is not evaluated.

150.20.20.1(1).explanation: A crisis care shelter must occupy the whole building with no other use, and must be regulated or supervised under Ontario or Canadian legislation.
